name: cohesivity-backend
description: Infra and on-the-fly backend for agentic tasks and projects by cohesivity.ai. Offers Postgres, hosting, storage, AI gateway, email inbox, and more through one API/MCP. No account or API key needed to get started.

capabilities.operation: Provision Redis, vector DB, realtime, auth, and other services

authentication.setup: Keys are created automatically by `npx --yes @cohesivity/init@0.8.3` and written to a local `.cohesivity` file. No account, sign-up, or OAuth needed.

privacy.disclosure: Source code, database contents, and stored files reside on Cohesivity infrastructure. Ephemeral tenants and all data expire after 72 hours unless claimed.

lifecycle.install: Loads the pinned skill (cohesivity-org/cohesivity-skill@13e0057). Creates nothing until a task needs infrastructure.
lifecycle.disable: Unloads the skill. No background processes to stop.
lifecycle.uninstall: Remove the plugin and any project-local `.cohesivity` credential file.

failure.noCredentials: Skill instructs the agent to bootstrap via npx @cohesivity/init. If bootstrap fails, the agent reports the error and stops.
failure.offline: HTTP calls return a network error; the agent reports it and stops. No retry loop.
failure.providerError: Non-2xx responses are reported with status and body. No secrets are included in error output.
failure.bounds: API responses are JSON with bounded size. The skill does not stream unbounded content or generate provider-sourced conclusions.
